display.purpose: The name only; letters rise in on load, second word indented 0.5em.

headline.purpose: Section titles, max 20ch, balanced. The Contacto close scales to clamp(2.5rem, 1.45rem + 3.8vw, 5rem) at 16ch.

title.purpose: Service names (weight 560), spread titles, credentials, process heading; opsz 24 to 32.

script.purpose: Only Dani's own phrases; 1.12 to 1.28em of the host, rotated -3 to -4deg, written in with a clip reveal. Carmín on light grounds, carmín luz on dark.

intro.purpose: One-sentence deck under a headline, max 46ch, secondary ink.

ui.purpose: Proof line, look captions, header links (0.9375rem), tooltips.

sticker-caps.purpose: Uppercase, only inside sticker bubbles (0.6875 to 0.75rem) and the cinta (0.8125rem).

stitch.name: stitch-width
stitch.purpose: Universal line weight for seams, dividers and stitched outlines.

stitch.name: seam
stitch.purpose: Top seam between sections, 14px below the top edge, inset to the gutter.

stitch.name: link-stitch
stitch.purpose: Stitch-link underline, sewn in from the left on hover.

stitch.name: inset-stitch
stitch.value: outline: 1.5px dashed rgba(243,244,246,.6 to .72); outline-offset: -5px to -7px
stitch.purpose: Top-stitch inside patches, tiles, the pompón, the cinta and labels.

stitch.name: thread
stitch.purpose: Seam and divider colour, set per fabric.

shadows.name: sticker-drop
shadows.purpose: Die-cut stickers and bubbles (a filter that follows the silhouette).

shadows.name: sticker-drop-dragging
shadows.purpose: A sticker while it is dragged.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state transition and reveal.

motion.name: colcha-transition
motion.purpose: The three.js retazos transition between looks.

motion.name: script-write
motion.value: clip-path reveal 1.3s ease-out, .1s delay (.75s in the hero hook)
motion.purpose: Dani's phrases write in as they enter view.

motion.name: name-rise
motion.value: 1s ease-out, 38ms stagger per letter, from translateY(.38em) rotate(5deg)

motion.name: cinta-scroll
motion.purpose: The ribbon marquee; pauses on hover.

motion.name: like-pop
motion.purpose: Carmín heart pop on a like.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animation and transition none; no particles, autoplay, bob or marquee; script always visible
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion. Save-Data also skips the three.js bundle.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Gutter 64px, two-column hero and splits, desktop nav, mini-colcha, no sticky bar.

narrative.northStar: La Colcha de Negros a Blancos
narrative.overview:
The whole page is one quilt. Each section is a whole piece of fabric with its own ground: Carnaval black, collage cream, talco white, potato-field green, barley yellow-green, ploughed-earth brown. A dashed top-stitch joins each piece to the one above. Three voices sit on that cloth. Bodoni Moda sets the fashion-editorial finish. Figtree carries the working text. Dani's own carmín script and halftone stickers, taken from her collage, put her hand on top. The textile ties the Andean colcha, the comparsa patchwork and a fashion designer's fabric together, so every recurring device is something sewn: stitches, patches, woven labels, ribbons, die-cut stickers.

Density is editorial and generous. Sections breathe on large vertical padding, portraits are large and carry the page, and colour arrives as whole fabrics or small stitched squares, never as gradients or tints. Motion is Carnaval air: talco and confeti drift in the hero, the portrait unstitches into patches between looks, stickers bob and can be dragged, and Dani's phrases write themselves in. One control pauses all of it, and reduced motion removes it entirely.
keyCharacteristics: Every section is one solid fabric ground, with its own ink, secondary ink, thread and script ink.
A dashed stitch (1.5px) is the universal line: seams, dividers, focus, inner outlines.
Square-cut cloth everywhere. Rounding is reserved for the pompón pill, the round icon buttons and the collage ovals.
Carmín script is Dani's voice and only hers.
Photography is the content; the colcha frames it and never covers it.

rules.name: The One Fabric Rule
rules.body: A section is one solid fabric from the retazo palette and sets four values: ink, secondary ink, thread (a translucent ink at 0.42 to 0.55 alpha) and, on dark fabrics, carmin-luz as script ink. Nothing inside it changes the ground except patches, labels and photographs.

rules.name: The Carmín Is Hers Rule
rules.body: The carmín family means Dani: her script, her stickers, and the one action of writing to her. Never use it for decoration, section grounds or generic emphasis.

rules.name: The Patch, Not Ground Rule
rules.body: Cobalto and naranja are too loud to be ground. They appear only as squares, patches and confeti.

rules.name: The Her Own Words Rule
rules.body: Yellowtail sets only Dani's own phrases ("pero dime Dani", "Yo te ayudo", "cositas chéveres", "¿Indecis@?"). Inside a heading it runs at 1.12 to 1.28em, rotated -3 to -4deg, and writes itself in with a clip reveal as it enters view. It is never used for navigation, labels or a whole paragraph.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Stay Sewn Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text lives only inside a physical object: a woven label, a sticker bubble or the cinta. Never above a heading.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Set Bodoni's opsz by hand to match the role (80, 40, 32, 24). Never leave a mid-size Bodoni at auto, where the hairlines break.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Sections never meet edge to edge without a stitch. Inside a section, lists divide with the same dashed thread, never with solid rules or boxes.

rules.name: The Only Objects Cast Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to things laid on the quilt: buttons, labels, ribbon and stickers. Fabrics, photographs, cards and lists stay flat. Shadows are always soft, blurred and offset downward, never hard-edged.

dos: **Do** give every new section one solid retazo fabric, its matching secondary ink and translucent thread, and a dashed seam at its top.
**Do** draw dividers, outlines and focus as the 1.5px dashed stitch.
**Do** route every conversion to WhatsApp through the carmín pompón, with carmín hondo on hover.
**Do** set Bodoni with an explicit optical size per role, and keep tracked caps inside labels, stickers and the cinta.
**Do** use carmin on light grounds and carmin-luz on dark grounds for script, so script ink stays at 4.5:1 or better.
**Do** let photographs carry the section, in 4:5 or 3:4 crops with a focal point set per image.
**Do** offer one pause for all ambient motion, and drop particles, autoplay, bob, marquee and write-in under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** round cloth. Sections, patches, tiles, labels and photographs stay square-cut. Pills and ovals are only for the pompón, the round icon buttons and the collage ovals.
**Don't** use the carmín family for decoration, section grounds or emphasis that isn't Dani's voice or the action of writing to her.
**Don't** use cobalto or naranja as a section ground.
**Don't** use Yellowtail for anything other than Dani's own phrases.
**Don't** use hard-edged shadows anywhere, and don't shadow fabrics or photographs.
**Don't** let the talco and confeti layer reach full strength over the portrait or the copy.
**Don't** fall back to a white page with a grey logo row; logos live as stitched tiles on a fabric.
